name: comp-549

frames.best_why: Six file rows of several types plus the Remove all button make the list fullest here.

tagline: Narrow file list with an icon, name and size for each upload.
summary: A tall uploader: a dashed drop box at the top and one bordered row per file below, each with a type icon, filename, size and an X, with a Remove all button under the list.
appearance: A narrow column on black. The top is a dashed rounded box with a small file-up circle, "Upload files", a browse line and a dim limits line. Below sit short bordered rows with a square icon tile, a name over its size, and a faint x, ending in an outlined Remove all files button.
behaviour: Dropping or clicking fills the list row by row from three to six files; each x drops its own row and Remove all clears everything. Dragging over the drop box tints it, and oversize or extra files raise a red warning.
demo_content: document.pdf, intro.zip, conclusion.xlsx, then cover-1/2/3.png; the caption links to an API doc.
search_phrases: upload several files in a list
file list with names sizes and remove buttons
bulk file upload with x per row
upload files and see their sizes
use_when: A form takes several documents of mixed types and each one must be removable on its own.
avoid_when: Rows show only name and size with no progress bar, so a slow upload gives no feedback.
customise: The ten-file cap, the 100MB ceiling and three seed files are written in the file; the file-type icons and row layout are source edits as well.
weight_why: A handful of seed rows and a hidden file input; no animation loop.

a11y.note: Remove buttons are labelled and focusable, but the dashed drop area sits outside the tab order.

issues: Rows never show upload progress, only the name and size.
The clickable drop area is left out of keyboard tabbing.
The caption is developer copy ending in an API link.
polish_why: Neat compact list with clear type icons and remove controls, but plain and developer-captioned.
title: Multi File Upload List
